title: Nontrivial Algebraic-Degree Bound for Feistel Schemes
summary: For Feistel schemes, only the trivial algebraic-degree bound is known; finding a strictly tighter upper bound on degree growth remains open.

formal_statement.body: Open problem. For Feistel schemes, no algebraic-degree bound improving on the trivial bound is known. Derive a nontrivial upper bound on algebraic-degree growth for Feistel schemes that is strictly tighter than the trivial bound.

scope.domain: Algebraic cryptanalysis of algebraic-degree growth in Feistel schemes.
parameters: Algebraic-degree growth: the quantity whose upper bound is to be improved
scope.unresolved_remainder: Derive a nontrivial upper bound on algebraic-degree growth for Feistel schemes that is strictly tighter than the trivial bound.

citations.label: On the Field-Based Division Property: Applications to MiMC, Feistel MiMC and GMiMC

progress.summary: The source contrasts improved bounds for other constructions with the absence of any bound beyond the trivial one for Feistel schemes. Its results for MiMC-like unbalanced Feistel constructions do not settle the general problem.
citation_labels: jiamin cui et al., On the Field-Based Division Property: Applications to MiMC, Feistel MiMC and GMiMC
